items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: Moe Gale and Mr. Buchanan, (Unintelligible) who was running the Savoy Ballroom for the Mogail people, wanted to sign us up.

ctx.x: We left there and went to Cincinnati, Ohio. No, we left there and went to Detroit, and played a theater there with Louis Jordan. We met Louis Jordan there, and we followed Lena Horne. And we played the theater in Detroit. Then we left Detroit, and came on down to Cincinnati, where we played the Jabberwocks. Our band had always been quite popular around Cincinnati. We played the Delta's Jabberwocks there. And they had a packed house, at Tapp Auditorium. And then we brought the band on back to St. Louis. That's all…

In the meantime, while out in New York, they wanted to sign us up. Moe Gale and Mr. Buchanan, (Unintelligible) who was running the Savoy Ballroom for the Mogail people, wanted to sign us up. But like I told you, in the contract everything's in their favor. And nothing in our favor. So we decided to come on back to St. Louis. And in the meantime, we had I think a three weeks booking at the Club Plantation, shortly before it closed. And before that, we went into the Tunetown Ballroom. We had a week's booking in the…
And my wife's father died. And I left and went to New York to the funeral. While in New York, I decided to go
